title: Powerwall Storm-Watch Early Exit
app: Tesla Powerwall, Enphase IQ, SolarEdge, Sense, Emporia Vue, DSMR / P1 smart meters, and utility tariff exports collected via vendor APIs, Home Assistant, MQTT, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=powerwall:aggregate mode=storm_watch
| sort 0 site_name _time
| streamstats current=f last(mode) as prev_mode by site_name
| eval exited=if(prev_mode="storm_watch" AND mode!="storm_watch",1,0)
| stats count(eval(exited=1)) as storm_watch_exits by site_name
| where storm_watch_exits>0
| sort - storm_watch_exits
description: Uses Powerwall mode changes telemetry to monitor unexpected exits from storm-watch mode in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for reserve behavior that may not match severe-weather expectations, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Powerwall mode changes data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It blends unexpected exits from storm-watch mode so you can spot reserve behavior that may not match severe-weather expectations before it becomes annoying.
